t: You're looking at the Black Lion, a Grade II* listed pub with accommodation on Kilburn High Road. It was built around 1898 to designs by the architect R. A. Lewcock, who lived from 1846 to 1932. What makes it special is the inside. It keeps a late Victorian interior that the Campaign for Real Ale rates three stars, a rating that means an interior of outstanding national historic importance. So if you step in, you're seeing a pub interior that has survived from Lewcock's day.
